mainEntity.name: What design considerations are important for a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key design considerations include layout for optimal flow and privacy, natural light and ventilation, soundproofing, and integration with the existing home's architecture. Think about the size of the bedroom, bathroom features (e.g., double vanity, walk-in shower, tub), closet space, and any desired sitting areas. Material choices, from flooring to fixtures, also play a crucial role in aesthetics and functionality. Our designers can help you plan a cohesive and comfortable space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Important design considerations include layout, natural light, soundproofing, integration with existing architecture, and specific features for the bedroom, bathroom, and closet.
